Public sources used to ground the MVP

  • HCC public site for current institutional color and imagery cues.
  • UCI Student Performance and OULAD for public higher-education-style table patterns. The app uses fictional records only.
  • Microsoft Learn references for Entra SSO, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint list writes, and Power BI embedded analytics.
